function.name: question_ask
function.description: This function prompts the user with a question and returns their response. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

prompt.description: The question to be presented to the user.

default_answer.description: The default answer to be used if the user provides no response.

timeout.description: The time in seconds to wait for the user to respond before timing out.

required.description: Whether a response to the prompt is required. If true, the function will reprompt until an answer is provided.
